name: fleet-core
description: Fleet-commons library plugin (Codex adapter): canonical home for cross-plugin shared primitives (tier palette, tier resolver, effort rider, retry/backoff) plus the vendored resolution shim's canonical copy. Scripts-only — no skills, commands, or agents.

interface.shortDescription: Shared model, effort, retry, and compatibility primitives.
interface.longDescription: Provides the scripts-only shared library used by Infiquetra Codex plugins for model catalogs, execution classes, effort policy, retry behavior, and compatibility readers.
defaultPrompt: Use Fleet Core only as a shared library dependency for another Infiquetra plugin.
